tasks.title: Augmented Reality for Training
paras: Augmented reality (AR) has emerged as a groundbreaking tool in the field of human performance technology, particularly in training environments. AR overlays digital information on the real world, providing immersive experiences that enhance learning and skill acquisition. For example, AR can simulate complex machinery operations, allowing trainees to interact with virtual components as if they were physically present. This hands-on approach helps learners understand intricate processes without the risks associated with real-world practice. The adaptability of AR makes it suitable for various industries. In medicine, AR can project 3D models of human anatomy, guiding surgeons through complex procedures. In aviation, pilots use AR to practice emergency protocols, offering a safe yet realistic training environment. Studies have shown that these AR applications significantly improve retention rates and performance outcomes. Moreover, AR's ability to customize training scenarios based on individual needs further enhances its effectiveness. However, integrating AR into training programs presents challenges. The technology requires substantial investment in hardware and software development. Additionally, creating accurate and responsive AR content demands expertise that many organizations may lack. Despite these hurdles, the benefits of AR in boosting human performance are undeniable. As the technology continues to evolve, it promises even more sophisticated and effective training solutions.

questions.stem: The word “groundbreaking” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：词汇题 原文定位：Augmented reality (AR) has emerged as a groundbreaking tool in the field of human performance technology. 正确答案分析：groundbreaking 意为 “开创性的、突破性的”，在文中指 AR 是一项具有革新意义的工具。revolutionary（革命性的、突破性的）含义最接近。 选项分析： (A) educational 教育的 —— 无关。 (B) practical 实用的 —— 不符合 “开创性” 含义。 (C) revolutionary 革命性的 —— 正确。 (D) interesting 有趣的 —— 无关。

questions.stem: What is the function of AR as described in the passage?

options.B: AR produces realistic experiences in a learning environment.
options.C: AR enables unskilled humans to interact with complex machines.
options.D: AR produces a digital record of real-world content.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节题 原文定位：AR overlays digital information on the real world, providing immersive experiences that enhance learning and skill acquisition. 正确答案分析：文中明确指出 AR 将数字信息叠加在现实世界，提供沉浸式、逼真的学习体验，对应选项 B。 选项分析： (A) AR artificially enhances human performance. —— 错误，文中是提升训练效果，不是 “人为增强体能”。 (B) AR produces realistic experiences in a learning environment. —— 正确。 (C) AR enables unskilled humans to interact with complex machines. —— 错误，是模拟操作，不是让无技能者直接操作。 (D) AR produces a digital record of real-world content. —— 错误，不是记录，而是叠加信息。

questions.stem: AR reduces which of the following problems associated with traditional training environments?

options.A: Their inability to simulate authentic experiences

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节题 原文定位：This hands-on approach helps learners understand intricate processes without the risks associated with real-world practice. 正确答案分析：文中强调 AR 可以让学习者在无风险的环境下练习，避免现实训练中的危险，因此减少了物理危险。 选项分析： (A) 无法模拟真实体验 —— 错误，AR 可以模拟。 (B) Their physical dangers 物理危险 —— 正确。 (C) 学习者难以接触 —— 文中未提。 (D) 高成本 —— 错误，AR 本身成本高。

questions.stem: Why does the author cite studies showing that AR improves retention rates?

options.A: To demonstrate its usefulness when practicing emergency protocols
options.B: To provide an example of its adaptability
options.C: To explain why fields outside medicine and aviation are slower to adopt it
options.D: To support the claim that it is useful to industries

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：Studies have shown that these AR applications significantly improve retention rates and performance outcomes. 正确答案分析：作者引用研究数据，是为了证明 AR 在各行业中确实有效、有价值，支持前文 “AR 适用于多个行业” 的观点。 选项分析： (A) 证明在紧急预案中有用 —— 只是例子，不是目的。 (B) 举例说明适应性 —— 错误。 (C) 解释其他行业采用慢 —— 无关。 (D) To support the claim that it is useful to industries —— 正确。

questions.stem: What is one problem the passage mentions related to the use of AR?

options.A: The costs associated with making it useful to particular clients
options.B: Disagreement among experts regarding its accuracy
options.C: A lack of measurable benefits in its present stage of development
options.D: The absence of existing training programs into which it may be integrated

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：细节题 原文定位：The technology requires substantial investment in hardware and software development. 正确答案分析：文中明确提出挑战：硬件、软件开发需要大量资金投入，对应选项 A 的成本问题。 选项分析： (A) The costs associated with making it useful to particular clients —— 正确，对应高额投资。 (B) 专家对准确性有争议 —— 文中未提。 (C) 缺乏可衡量收益 —— 错误，研究证明有收益。 (D) 没有可整合的现有项目 —— 错误，文中未提。
